Code of conduct

Source: CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md

HapBlockR is committed to a respectful, inclusive, and professionally constructive community.

Participants must communicate with care, welcome relevant experience from breeders, quantitative geneticists, data stewards, software engineers, and students, and criticise ideas or evidence rather than people. Harassment, discrimination, intimidation, deliberate disclosure of private information, and sustained disruptive behaviour are unacceptable.

Project maintainers may edit, remove, or reject contributions and may temporarily or permanently restrict participation when conduct threatens the safety, dignity, or effective work of the community. Reports may be sent privately to the package maintainer at akohoue.f@gmail.com. Reports will be handled as confidentially as practical, with conflicts of interest avoided.

This policy applies in project repositories, issue trackers, reviews, community meetings, and other spaces where a person represents HapBlockR.

Developed by Félicien Akohoue.
